parsing_notes: PDF has 4 pages; competition metadata were read from the repeated page header 'Ostravská stovka / Ostrava 29. srpna 2020'.
Competition name was taken as a specific event title; date normalized from '29. srpna 2020' to '2020-08-29'.
Discipline for all categories was determined as '100m' from the event title 'stovka' and the table context of hurdle race results.

Categories on pages 2 and 4 were split using the yellow-highlighted rank cells in the rendered pages, as instructed: highlighted rows were assigned to 'Starší dorostenky' and 'Starší dorostenci'; non-highlighted rows remained in 'Ženy' and 'Muži'.
Pages 1 and 3 contain separate blocks 'mladší' and 'střední'; these were mapped directly to 'Mladší dorostenky', 'Střední dorostenky', 'Mladší dorostenci' and 'Střední dorostenci'.
Column detection was based on visible table headers. Where the fscode column was absent (pages 2 and 4 combined categories), fscode was stored as null.
Blank attempt cells were stored as {time: null, status: 'invalid'} according to the instruction for unfilled times.
Rows marked only by the trailing label 'starší dorostenky' / 'starší dorostenci' were not treated as result rows.
warnings: competition.league could not be determined unambiguously; set to null.
No district/okres column is present in the tables; district was set to null for all results.
Birth year is not present for categories on pages 1 and 3; birth_year was set to null for those results.
Some page-2 and page-4 rows had category membership inferred from yellow row highlighting in the rendered pages because the textual export merges women's/men's and older-youth results.
Some results contain missing attempts and/or missing final times; these were stored as invalid with null time.
For combined women/older-girls and men/older-boys tables, repeated rank values belong to separate highlighted/non-highlighted categories and were preserved from the PDF where identifiable.
The older-youth split on pages 2 and 4 is based on visual highlighting; one or more boundary rows may remain slightly ambiguous in the parsed text alone.
